change.title: pr-5
change.description: adding flexbox to header via mixins (all prefixes)
change.author: awesomerobot

findings.title: Small-action edit/delete buttons no longer sit at the right edge of the row
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container (line 264), so `.small-action-desc` becomes a flex item. A flex item without `flex-grow` is only as wide as its content. Before this change it was a block that filled the 755px row (desktop/topic-post.scss:730-733), with `padding-left: 4em` to clear the floated avatar. The delete and edit `<button>`s are inside `.small-action-desc` (templates/components/small-action.hbs:4-9) and keep `float: right` (topic-post.scss:306-310). They now float to the right edge of a box that has shrunk to fit its text, so on a short action like "closed this topic" they end up right beside the text, not at the right side of the post. Adding `flex: 1` (with prefixes, e.g. a `flex` mixin) to `.small-action-desc` keeps the old full-width layout. Time-gap items (components/time-gap.js.es6) share this component and stylesheet.

findings.title: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property
findings.body: IE10 uses `-ms-flex-align`, which line 120 already emits. No browser has shipped `-ms-align-items`, so line 121 is dead output. Also, `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` take `start`/`end` where the modern syntax takes `flex-start`/`flex-end`. The mixin passes `$alignment` straight through, so it is only correct for `center`, `baseline` and `stretch`. Those are the only values used today, but a later `@include align-items(flex-start)` would quietly do nothing in the legacy syntaxes.

contracts.action: Header `.contents` becomes a flex row; `.panel` moved right with `margin-left:auto` + order 3, `.extra-info-wrapper` order 2, `.title` float removed
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous float layout: `.title` float left, `.panel` float right
contracts.before_after: DOM order is logo, panel, extra-info (templates/header.hbs:4-95). With order 0/2/3 the visual order is logo, extra-info, panel, and panel is pushed right by its auto margin, matching the old float result. The legacy box-ordinal-group defaults to 1 for unordered items, so the relative order holds in old WebKit too. The clearfix ::before/::after on `.contents` become empty flex items of zero size.
contracts.visible_effect: Header items are vertically centered rather than float-aligned; extra-info is hidden under 570px (desktop/header.scss:16-19)

contracts.action: `.small-action` becomes a flex row with centered items
contracts.equivalent_path: Previous block layout: avatar floated left, desc padded 4em, buttons floated right across the full row width
contracts.before_after: Before, desc filled the row and the buttons floated to its right edge. After, desc shrinks to fit its content, so the floated buttons sit right next to the text.
contracts.visible_effect: Edit/delete controls on small-action and time-gap posts move off the right edge

summary: This PR swaps the header's floats for flexbox and adds prefixed flex mixins. The new mixins are reachable from header.scss, topic-post.scss, topic.scss and the badges stylesheet, because common.scss imports foundation/mixins before components/* and base/*. The header reorder is correct: visually it reads logo, then extra-info, then panel, which matches the old float layout. One layout regression: `.small-action` also becomes a flex container, so `.small-action-desc` shrinks to fit its text, and the floated edit/delete buttons no longer reach the right edge of the row. Minor: the align-items mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which no browser supports.
